messages:
Aisha: Quick async scrub — Nimbus private deploy: networking + air-gap blockers. Need owners and short status for registry mirror, L7 TLS certs, customer NAT, and egress fallback.
Cheng: I can take registry mirror ownership, progress ~50%. Found auth config gap causing pulls to fail.
Lucas: Who's on L7 proxy TLS cert rotation? We should check expiry and SANs.
Ravi: I'll own certs. Current certs expire 2026-06-10, CA rotation pending from sec. Will draft rotation steps.
Olivia: Customer (AcadiaHealth) still needs to confirm NAT mapping and will share by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy-checker: image-mirror sync failed 2026-02-20 — last error: HTTP 403 Forbidden.
Cheng: Saw the 403 — missing auth token in mirror config. I'll open a PR for mirror auth and add tests.
Aisha: Ping @Ravi @Cheng — please add explicit owners to the rollout doc and link the runbook. Also we need an egress fallback plan if direct egress is blocked.
Lucas: Egress smoke planned Wed 09:00 PT. I will run traceroute, curl to registry, and a kv-cache warm-up. Can someone post the firewall/egress port list we need?
Ravi: Minimal egress ports we require: 443 outbound to registries and S3, 50051 to control plane, 2379 to etcd. Snippet: 
```
# minimal egress
allow tcp 443 to registry.redwood-infra.com
allow tcp 443 to s3.amazonaws.com
allow tcp 50051 to control.redwood.svc
```
Aisha: @Olivia can you confirm the customer allows those egress destinations/ports? Also for air-gap: can they provide an internal registry mirror and the CA bundle?
Olivia: They can host an internal mirror but it's behind a strict ACL. They will provide a CA cert bundle and ACL spreadsheet in the handoff doc.
Cheng: PR ready for mirror auth change: PR #4823 — pinging @Lucas for review.
Lucas: Reviewing now, aim to finish by EOD. One ask: avoid full-node reboots during image sync window — prefer rolling restarts.
Ravi: Note: cert rotation may require envoy reloads; without graceful reloads we risk short connection drops. Ops to confirm reload playbook.
Aisha: Action items summarized: Cheng -> mirror auth PR & mirror smoke; Ravi -> cert rotation plan + reload playbook; Lucas -> egress smoke & CR review; Olivia -> customer NAT, ACL, and CA bundle. Update this thread when done. :eyes:
Olivia: Uploaded handoff docs to the shared folder (link in the doc). Flagged a question: will traceroute from bastion suffice to prove node-level access?
Cheng: PR merged at 1777777899 :tada: Mirror auth fix merged, local mirror smoke passed.
deploy-bot: canary-check: registry sync healthy on canary nodes.
Lucas: Egress smoke: traceroute and curl succeed from bastion, but nodes are blocked by customer ACL for direct outbound. We need to route node egress via bastion proxy or add NAT rule. Marking as TODO for netops.
Ravi: I'll coordinate with netops tomorrow morning to open the NAT rule request and get it prioritized. After NAT is in place I'll re-run smoke tests.
Aisha: Closing criteria agreed: 1) NAT rule applied or proxy path; 2) mirror reachable from nodes; 3) cert rotation plan + rollback doc present. If those pass, we can mark network blockers cleared. Reopen thread if failures. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
